title: SCA Minhag of the Week 281: "How to Wear a Talet”

chapters.title: Wearing the tallit according to the Shulchan Aruch
chapters.about: Two corners in front and two in back

chapters.title: Customs in North Africa and the opinion of Hacham Yosef Messas
Customs in Halab and the views of local rabbis
chapters.about: Practices of the community and rabbis in Halab

chapters.title: Summary of tallit customs and improper ways to wear it
chapters.about: Halachic requirements and avoiding wearing it like a scarf

summary: This class discusses the different customs for wearing a tallit during prayer. It examines the practice of wearing two corners in front and two in back as recorded in the Shulchan Aruch, compared to the custom of wearing all four corners in front as practiced in many Middle Eastern and North African communities.
questions: Should I wear my tallit with two corners in front and two in back?
Is it a requirement to have two corners in front and two in back to fulfill the mitzvah of tzitzit?
What was the custom in Halab regarding how to wear a tallit?
Is it proper to wear a tallit folded like a scarf?
